title.narrative: Integrated multi-sector assistance to support conflict- induced IDPs in Degem woreda of North Shewa Zone, Oromia Region (Priority –2 )

description.narrative: ltpgtFIDO proposes an integrated multi-sector assistance project to support vulnerable communities in conflict-affected Degem Woreda, North Shewa zone, Oromia Region. The conflict involving UAG has left approximately 5,186 IDPs (2,481 M and 2,687 F) in Hambuso and Alidoro towns in urgent need of lifesaving assistance (source: woreda Busa Gonfa). Overcrowding, inadequate WASH facilities, and a lack of health and nutrition services increase exposure to GBV and communicable diseases.ltbrgtThe project focuses on Cash, Health, Nutrition, Emergency Shelter/NFIs, and WASH. For MPC, 340 households will receive two rounds of cash per the Oromia CWG guidelines. The Nutrition and Health sectors will support 13,867 individuals, focusing on infants, young children, and pregnant/lactating women, through screenings, mental health support, and health system strengthening. Mobile Health and Nutrition Teams (MHNT) will extend services to hard-to-reach areas, targeting 28,705 individuals with essential health services, including OPD consultations, ANC/PNC, skilled deliveries, and immunization campaigns. The outbreak response will include last-mile delivery of essential medication, including SAM treatment.ltbrgtThe WASH sector aims to improve access to safe water and sanitation for 5,186 people. This includes rehabilitating water schemes by replacing pumps in two hand-dug wells and distributing life-saving WASH NFIs to 450 households. Desludging three communal and one health facility latrine, and improving solid waste disposal at three health facilities are also planned.ltbrgtUnder emergency shelter, cash support for rental will be provided to 350 conflict-affected households (16% PWD). Training on AAP, PSEAH, and GBV will be provided to communities, government staff, and project committees. Regular monitoring and PDM will ensure effective implementation.ltbrgtDesigned in consultation with relevant Clusters and complementing other CERF/CBPF-funded projects, this project aims to tackle complex challenges, provide immediate lifesaving assistance, and promote dignity in Degem woreda with a total budget of $599,999.94 for a nine-month duration.lt/pgt
